name: What is involved in the process of getting an accessibility upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the process of getting an accessibility upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to assess your needs and the existing space. Next, we develop a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, timeline, and cost. Once approved, we assist with obtaining any necessary permits. Construction then proceeds, followed by a final inspection to ensure the upgrade meets specifications and satisfaction. We keep you informed at each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, proposal, permitting, construction, and a final inspection, with communication throughout.
